label: 仓鼠军营 LV3 · 现代步兵军营
designIntent: replace the rejected medieval-industrial LV3 white model with a present-day infantry field barracks
keep the stable runtime 2x2 footprint while changing only the authored visual model
use one slightly reduced military tent as the dominant mass and one lookout tower as the only vertical landmark
use the released ground for three organized equipment zones rather than random field clutter
lv3Structure: exactly one complete olive-drab ridge tent with one continuous canvas roof
one open tied-back tent entrance and exactly two rolled canvas windows
exactly one open four-post steel lookout tower with cross braces
one observation deck, complete railings, fixed ladder and small canvas canopy
one short connector landing joining the tower side to the tent compound
exactly two short low sandbag stacks beside the entrance
one left-side stack of exactly three ammunition crates
one right-side supply group of exactly two crates and two jerry cans
one tower-side service group with one field radio and one cable spool
the open entrance and fixed tower ladder remain unobstructed
all components remain inside the original 2x2 foundation
negativeConstraints: no medieval stone hall, half-timber facade, red tile roof or castle battlements
no second tent, second tower, detached hut or bunker
no perimeter fence, chain-link fence, barbed wire, camouflage-net canopy or obstacle course
no radar, antenna mast, flag, soldiers, hamsters, weapons or turret
no tank, armored vehicle, truck, helicopter, neon, sci-fi machinery or readable text
no random scattered clutter, extra crates or extra fuel cans
